responses.What services do you offer?: We provide AI-powered chatbots for customer support, lead generation, appointment booking, FAQ handling, and customer engagement. Our solutions are designed to help businesses save time, improve response rates, and deliver support 24/7.
responses.How much does it cost?: We offer flexible pricing plans to suit businesses of all sizes. Plans start at ₹799/month, with Pro and Enterprise options available for growing businesses that need advanced features and higher usage limits.
responses.Can I get a demo?: Absolutely! You're already interacting with a live demo. For a personalized demonstration tailored to your business needs, simply click the 'Get Free Demo' button and our team will reach out.
responses.How does it work?: Getting started is simple: 1) Tell us about your business, 2) We create and customize your AI chatbot, 3) The chatbot is deployed on your website or platform, 4) It starts interacting with customers instantly.
responses.What industries do you serve?: Our chatbot solutions are suitable for restaurants, retail stores, healthcare providers, educational institutions, fitness centers, real estate agencies, service businesses, and many other industries.
responses.Is it easy to setup?: Yes! Our setup process is quick and beginner-friendly. Most businesses can get started within minutes, and our team provides assistance throughout the onboarding process.
responses.pricing: Our pricing is designed to be affordable and scalable. Whether you're a startup, small business, or enterprise, we offer plans that fit your requirements and budget.
responses.demo: You're currently experiencing a live chatbot demo. This demonstrates how an AI assistant can answer questions, engage visitors, and help convert leads into customers.
